Schedule 9 Firearms Using Shot Only Areas (Section 10 (1) (a))
Quadra Island
28 That portion of the Province of British Columbia on Quadra Island, lying above the mean high water mark and south of the midline of North Gowland Harbour Road and Lakberg Road. [en. B.C. Reg. 157/2022, App. 3, s. 6.]
